title: #018. University Degree & Prerequisite Course Planner
subtitle: Select courses under multi-category workload caps, prerequisite pairs, and schedule conflicts.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { take, totalInterest }.
judge.m3: Prerequisite violated: taking course {p0} requires taking prerequisite course {p1}.
judge.m4: Time conflict violated: courses {p0} and {p1} cannot both be taken.
judge.m5: Reported totalInterest ({p0}) does not match computed interest ({p1}).
judge.m6: Feasible course plan, but totalInterest ({p0}) is below optimal ({p1}).
